findings.claim: s10_21_residual_and_runtime.md stage table: 'calls/run' 2/4/2/4/2/2 (gvf/Lcyl/Kside/Lside/anilum/shadow) with note 'the calls/run column shows the 3-rep accumulator divided by 3'.
findings.evidence: True per-run call counts (residual_profile_out.json per_run_accumulators, identical in all 3 reps): gvf 14, Lcyl 24, Kside 14, Lside 24, anilum 14, shadow 14. The repo JSON's calls_per_run 4/8/4/8/4/4 is floor(last-run count / TIMED=3), itself a mislabeled derivation; the doc's 2/4/2/4/2/2 matches neither (it is half the JSON value). The stated derivation is doubly wrong: the harness reset()s the accumulator before each rep, so it never holds a 3-rep sum. Also note the shares table is computed from the FINAL rep only (calc_s 0.7087 = rep-3 calc; rep-1 calc was 0.82243, which would give gvf 27.1%/Lcyl 38.0%/Kside 21.3%), while tile_total_s is the mean of the 3 reps.
findings.recommended_fix: Correct the doc column to the true per-run counts (14/24/14/24/14/14) or to the JSON field with an accurate derivation note; state that the shares are final-rep shares; fix the harness's calls_per_run derivation (or drop it, per_run_accumulators already carries the truth) before the next profile run. No percentage or S10-22 selection decision changes: rankings are stable across reps and the JSON/raw data are correct.
